scripts.build: node apps/web/tools/stamp-deploy.mjs && bun run registry && bun run site:css && bun run specimen:css && bun run buttons && bun run --filter @mauricekleine/web build
scripts.build:superthread: node apps/superthread/tools/stamp-deploy.mjs && bun run --cwd packages/superthread build && bun run --cwd packages/superthread registry --out ../../apps/superthread/public && bun run --filter @mauricekleine/superthread-site build
scripts.deploy:preview: cd apps/web && cf workers versions create --prebuilt
scripts.dev: bun run registry && bun run site:css && bun run specimen:css && bun run buttons && bun run --filter @mauricekleine/web dev
scripts.dev:superthread: bun run --cwd packages/superthread build && bun run --cwd packages/superthread registry --out ../../apps/superthread/public && bun run --filter @mauricekleine/superthread-site dev
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/superthread test && bun run --cwd apps/web test && bun run --cwd apps/share test && bun run --cwd apps/superthread test
